title: HR Professional (Open Rank: Senior – Principal)
description:
University Staff
**Description** **University of Colorado Anschutz**

**Department: Barbara Davis Center for Diabetes**

**Job Title: HR Professional (Open Rank: Senior – Principal)**

**Position \#: 00800754– Requisition \#:40722**

 **Job Summary:**

  

The full\-time HR Senior or Principal Professional will be responsible for recruitment, on\-boarding, off\-boarding, employee relations, training and development, faculty affairs and payroll processes for the BDC. This individual will maintain a working knowledge of all relevant policies and procedures and serve as a resource for faculty and staff on matters related to recruitment, onboarding, orientation, off\-boarding, payroll processes, leave, performance management, and professional development. This position will work closely with University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus and School of Medicine Human Resources units, as well as with the University’s Employee Services Department.


Expected Rank Scope:

* Senior Professional Broad HR practitioner Independently manages the full employee lifecycle and provides HR guidance across all functional areas. Handles complex issues with minimal supervision.
* Principal Professional Subject Matter Expert Serves as the recognized expert in multiple HR disciplines, advises leadership on complex organizational issues, develops HR processes, and leads cross\-functional initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead full\-cycle recruitment for a diverse workforce, including faculty, staff, researchers, fellows, students, and other academic personnel.
* Partner with hiring managers and search committees to facilitate effective, compliant recruitment and hiring processes.
* Manage the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, and faculty affairs processes.
* Serve as a trusted HR resource, providing guidance on policies, leave administration, accommodations, performance management, and employee relations.
* Administer payroll and leave processes, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reconciliation.
* Collaborate with campus and School of Medicine HR partners to ensure compliance with university policies and deliver exceptional HR service.
* Maintain confidential personnel records and contribute to continuous improvement of HR programs and processes.
 **Work Location:**

  

Hybrid – this role is eligible for a hybrid schedule of 3 days per week on campus and as needed for in\-person meetings after an initial 90\-day probationary period in which you must work full\-time, in person.

 **Why Join Us:**

  

The Barbara Davis Center for Diabetes (BDC) is the largest diabetes institute in the world specializing in type 1 diabetes research and care for children and adults. Over 235 clinicians, clinical researchers, basic biomedical scientists and supporting staff work at the BDC to find the most effective treatment, prevention, and cure for type 1 diabetes. The Center provides state\-of\-the\-art diabetes care to over 7,500 children and adults with diabetes, as well as inpatient care at the Children’s Hospital Colorado.

**Why work for the University?**

  

We have AMAZING benefits and offerexceptional amounts of holiday, vacation and sick leave! The University of Colorado offers an excellent benefits package including:

  

* Medical: Multiple plan options
* Dental: Multiple plan options
* Additional Insurance: Disability, Life, Vision
* Retirement 401(a) Plan: Employer contributes 10% of your gross pay
* Paid Time Off: Accruals over the year
* Vacation Days: 22/year (maximum accrual 352 hours)
* Sick Days: 15/year (unlimited maximum accrual)
* Holiday Days: 15/year
* Tuition Benefit: Employees have access to this benefit on all CU campuses
* ECO Pass: Reduced rate RTD Bus and light rail service

  

There are many additional perks \& programs with the CU Advantage.

 **Qualifications:**

 **Minimum Qualifications:**


Senior Rank

* A bachelor’s degree in human resources, business, public administration, higher education administration, social sciences, behavioral sciences or a directly related field from an accredited institution.
* Two years (2\) of experience working in human resources.


Principal Rank

* A bachelor’s degree in human resources, business, public administration, higher education administration, social sciences, behavioral sciences or a directly related field from an accredited institution.
* Three years (3\) of experience working in human resources.

*Applicants must meet minimum qualifications at the time of hire.*

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in human resources, public administration, business, higher education administration, or a directly related field from an accredited institution.
* Experience working with Peoplesoft Human Capital Management, CU Careers, PRiSM
* Experience working in human resources in a higher education or healthcare setting.
* Experience working with accounting and financial data effectively analyzing as well as identifying variances.

**Conditions of Employment:**

* Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without requiring sponsorship. We are unable to provide work visa sponsorship or employment authorization for this position now or in the future.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Strong independent judgement and critical thinking skills.
* Ability to analyze, interpret, and evaluate a broad range of laws, rules, and regulations in order to exercise good judgment in applying them to human resource challenges.
* Knowledge of the professional standards, concepts, and practices of recruitment, organizational development and human resource policy.
* Ability to communicate effectively, both in writing and orally, including public speaking.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with employees at all levels throughout the institution.
* Ability to work independently, as well as part of a team.
* Demonstrated commitment and leadership ability to advance diversity and inclusion.
* Thorough knowledge of current management and leadership methods and best practices.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to plan, organize, implement and coordinate complex human resource activities.
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information and documents and maintain strict confidentiality in all HR matters.
 **How to Apply:**

  

For full consideration, please submit the following document(s):

* A letter of interest describing relevant job experiences as they relate to listed job qualifications and interest in the position
* Curriculum vitae / Resume
* Three to five professional references, including name, address, phone number (mobile number if appropriate), and email address


Questions should be directed to: BDCHR@cuanschutz.edu

 **Screening of Applications Begins:**

  

Applications will be accepted until finalists are identified, but preference will be given to complete applications received by August 20, 2026\. Those who do not apply by this date may or may not be considered.

 **Anticipated Pay Range:**

  

The starting salary range (or hiring range) for this position has been established as

* Senior Rank: $57,073 \- $72,597
* Principal Rank: $65,637 \- $83,487


The above salary range (*or hiring range*) represents the University’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. This position may be eligible for overtime compensation, depending on the level.


Your total compensation goes beyond the number on your paycheck. The University of Colorado provides generous leave, health plans and retirement contributions that add to your bottom line.


Total Compensation Calculator

 **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:**

  

CU is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. We are committed to creating a workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity, and we encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.

 **ADA Statement:**

  

The University will provide reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities throughout the employment application process. To request an accommodation pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Human Resources ADA Coordinator at hr.adacoordinator@cuanschutz.edu.

 **Background Check Statement:**

  

The University of Colorado Anschutz is dedicated to ensuring a safe and secure environment for our faculty, staff, students and visitors. To assist in achieving that goal, we conduct background investigations for all prospective employees.

 **Vaccination Statement:**

  

CU Anschutz strongly encourages vaccination against the COVID\-19 virus and other vaccine preventable diseases. If you work, visit, or volunteer in healthcare facilities or clinics operated by our affiliated hospital or clinical partners or by CU Anschutz, you will be required to comply with the vaccination and medical surveillance policies of the facilities or clinics where you work, visit, or volunteer, respectively. In addition, if you work in certain research areas or perform certain safety sensitive job duties, you must enroll in the occupational health medical surveillance program.

title: Research Scientist / Scholar I, II, or III
description:
**Job Description**
===================

**Position Summary:**
---------------------

Research Scientists/Scholars support the research mission of the School of Biomedical and Chemical Engineering through the development, execution, and dissemination of scholarly research activities. These positions conduct independent and collaborative research, contribute original and creative scholarly work, develop externally funded research programs, mentor students and research personnel, publish scientific findings, and contribute to the advancement of the School's research portfolio.


Appointments may be made at the Research Scientist/Scholar I, II, or III level based on the candidate's qualifications, experience, accomplishments, and demonstrated research independence. Assignments are based on departmental needs, available funding, research priorities, and the qualifications and expertise of the selected candidate.


Rank will be determined based on the successful candidate's education, experience, scholarly accomplishments, funding history, and demonstrated level of research independence consistent with Colorado State University's Research Scientist/Scholar career framework. Research Scientist/Scholar I appointments are typically appropriate for individuals with less than three years of postdoctoral or equivalent research experience. Research Scientist/Scholar II appointments are typically appropriate for individuals with at least three years of postdoctoral or equivalent research experience and demonstrated independent research accomplishments. Research Scientist/Scholar III appointments are typically appropriate for individuals with at least seven years of postdoctoral or equivalent research experience and a demonstrated record of significant scholarly achievement, research leadership, and professional service.


**Department Name:**
--------------------

School of Biomedical and Chemical Engineering


**Anticipated Start Date:**
---------------------------

Varies based on departmental needs and available funding.


Salary Range:


$67,226 \- $89,000


**Anticipated Weekly Hours:**
-----------------------------

Full\-time. Work schedules may vary based on research activities, project requirements, and funding obligations. Occasional evening, weekend, or travel commitments may be required.


**Essential Duties:**
---------------------

* Develop and conduct independent and collaborative research programs aligned with the mission and strategic priorities of the School.
* Design, execute, analyze, and interpret research studies and experiments.
* Prepare and publish scholarly manuscripts, technical reports, and other research products.
* Develop and submit proposals to federal agencies, foundations, industry sponsors, and other funding organizations.
* Collaborate with faculty investigators, research staff, students, and external partners on sponsored and non\-sponsored research activities.
* Mentor undergraduate students, graduate students, research personnel, and postdoctoral scholars as appropriate.
* Present research findings at scientific conferences, professional meetings, and other scholarly venues.
* Maintain compliance with applicable federal, state, university, sponsor, laboratory safety, and research integrity requirements.
* Contribute to the growth and advancement of the School's research enterprise through collaboration, innovation, and scholarly engagement.
* Participate in service activities that support the research mission of the School, College, University, and scientific profession.
* Assist in the development of research infrastructure, laboratory capabilities, and collaborative partnerships that advance the School's strategic goals.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Conditions of Employment:**
-----------------------------

* Required Criminal History Background Check.
* Successful completion of all required University onboarding and compliance training.
* Compliance with University policies regarding laboratory safety, biosafety, chemical hygiene, research integrity, export controls, data security, and responsible conduct of research, as applicable.
* Ability to work safely in laboratory, field, clinical, manufacturing, computational, or other research environments associated with assigned projects.
* Legal authorization to work in the United States by the proposed start date. Sponsorship may be available consistent with University policy.
* Occasional travel may be required.
* Occasional evening or weekend work may be required to support research activities.

**Supervision:**
----------------

May provide technical direction, mentoring, project leadership, or research oversight to students, research personnel, and other project participants. Direct supervisory responsibilities, if any, will be determined by project and funding needs.


**Required Job Qualifications:**
--------------------------------

**Research Scientist/Scholar I:**

* Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, Biology, or a closely related engineering or scientific discipline.
* Normally less than three years of postdoctoral or equivalent research experience following completion of the doctoral degree.
* Demonstrated ability to conduct independent and collaborative scholarly research.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze and interpret scientific data.
* Evidence of scholarly productivity through publications, presentations, or other research outputs.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to contribute to research projects individually and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

**Research Scientist/Scholar II:**

* Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, Biology, or a closely related engineering or scientific discipline.
* Normally at least three years of postdoctoral or equivalent research experience.
* Demonstrated record of independent scholarly research and scientific productivity.
* Evidence of publications in refereed journals and presentations at scientific meetings.
* Demonstrated ability to participate in the planning and execution of research programs.
* Demonstrated ability to contribute to the development of externally funded research projects.

**Research Scientist/Scholar III:**

* Ph.D. in Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, Biology, or a closely related engineering or scientific discipline.
* Normally at least seven years of postdoctoral or equivalent research experience.
* Demonstrated record of significant scholarly accomplishment and research independence.
* Evidence of sustained publication in refereed journals and presentations at national or international scientific meetings.
* Demonstrated success in obtaining or contributing substantially to externally funded research.
* Demonstrated leadership within research programs, professional organizations, or scientific collaborations.
* Demonstrated potential for continued leadership and growth within the research profession.

**Preferred Job Qualifications:**
---------------------------------

* Experience working in multidisciplinary research environments.
* Experience developing or supporting externally funded research proposals.
* Experience mentoring undergraduate students, graduate students, postdoctoral scholars, or research personnel.
* Experience collaborating with academic, government, healthcare, industry, or community partners.
* Experience presenting research findings at national or international conferences.
* Demonstrated record of research innovation, technology development, intellectual property generation, or translational research activities.
* For Research Scientist/Scholar III, evidence of professional service, committee participation, conference organization, workshop leadership, scientific outreach, or other contributions to the research profession.
* Experience working in one or more areas aligned with the School's research mission, including biomedical engineering, chemical engineering, biomaterials, biotechnology, advanced manufacturing, translational research, computational modeling, medical devices, sustainability, energy, or related disciplines.

**Application Instructions:**
-----------------------------

To apply, please upload a resume and cover letter. This is an **evergreen** posting. Applications will be reviewed as hiring needs arise, and qualified applicants may be contacted by individual faculty members if a suitable opportunity becomes available.


This posting will remain open until December 31, 2026\. Applicants wishing to be considered beyond this date must reapply.


Please note, applicants may redact information from their application materials that identifies their age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.


**Employee Benefits**
=====================

Colorado State University is not just a workplace; it’s a thriving community that’s transforming lives and improving the human condition through world\-class teaching, research, and service. With a robust benefits package, collaborative atmosphere, and focus on work\-life balance, CSU is where you can thrive, grow, and make a lasting impact.

* 

**Background Check Policy Statement**
=====================================

Colorado State University strives to provide a safe study, work, and living environment for its faculty, staff, volunteers and students. To support this environment and comply with applicable laws and regulations, CSU conducts background checks for the finalist before a final offer. The type of background check conducted varies by position and can include, but is not limited to, criminal history, sex offender registry, motor vehicle history, financial history, and/or education verification. Background checks will also be conducted when required by law or contract and when, in the discretion of the University, it is reasonable and prudent to do so.


**EEO**
=======

Colorado State University (CSU) provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
